label: s1_sub_017_man_01
text: Hey, kid. Your Pokémon look strong.

label: s1_sub_017_man_02
text: Hey, kid. Your Pokémon look strong.

label: s1_sub_017_man_03
text: You just might have what it takes to challenge\nthe Kitakami Ogre Clan.

label: s1_sub_017_select_01
text: The Kitakami Ogre Clan?

label: s1_sub_017_select_02
text: Who in the world...?

label: s1_sub_017_man_04
text: There’s a group of strong Trainers in ogre masks\nwho’ve been popping up outside the village.\r\nThey call themselves the Kitakami Ogre Clan.

label: s1_sub_017_man_05
text: They’re always on the hunt for the next battle...\nand tough kids like you are their favorite foes.

label: s1_sub_017_man_06
text: Rumor has it the Kitakami Ogre Clan’s got seven\nmembers in all...

label: s1_sub_017_man_07
text:
If you’re gonna battle them, watch yourself.
They may be trickier to beat than you’d think.\c
I’ll give ya something cool for each member you
do manage to defeat, though.

label: s1_sub_017_man_08
text: Heard you beat a member of the Kitakami Ogre\nClan! Here’s your cool prize, as promised.

label: s1_sub_017_man_09
text: Heard you beat some members of the Kitakami\nOgre Clan! Here’re your cool prizes,\r\nas promised.

label: s1_sub_017_man_10
text: There’s just one member left... Want a hint for\nwhere they might be?

label: s1_sub_017_man_11
text: There are [VAR 0x0200(0001)] members of the Kitakami Ogre Clan\nleft... Want a hint for where one of ’em might be?

label: s1_sub_017_hint_01
text: “Leave Oni Mountain and follow the blue. Find\nsome bamboo, and you’ll find me!”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!

label: s1_sub_017_hint_02
text: “You will find me in a place where many gaze out\nupon the Oni’s horn.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!

label: s1_sub_017_hint_03
text: “You will find me in the ravine beside the water\nthat flows from the Oni’s mouth.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!

label: s1_sub_017_hint_04
text: “Trapped low down between the infernal and\na paradise, you will find me beside the water.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!

label: s1_sub_017_hint_05
text: “You will find me in a wasteland of peculiar rocks\nin a land with no suffering.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!

label: s1_sub_017_hint_06
text: “Upon the shorter of the Oni’s horns—that is\nwhere you will find me standing.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!

label: s1_sub_017_hint_07
text: “Descend a hole beside a pool that is never\ndark, and you will find me.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!

label: s1_sub_017_man_12
text: And with that...it seems you’ve defeated every\nlast member of the Kitakami Ogre Clan.

label: s1_sub_017_man_13
text: With an opponent as strong as you, I think I can\nactually go all out...

label: s1_sub_017_man_14
text: Hah!

label: s1_sub_017_man_15
text: I am the one and only secret master of the\nKitakami Ogre Clan!

label: s1_sub_017_man_16
text: The final battle is nigh. Let me know once you’ve\nprepared yourself.

label: s1_sub_017_man_17
text: One last battle with me... I trust that your\npreparations are in place?

label: s1_sub_017_man_18
text: ... ... ...\c\nThen return when you are ready.

label: s1_sub_017_man_30
text: Let’s go somewhere more suited for battle.\nCome with me.

label: s1_sub_017_man_19
text: I am Muramasa, secret master of the Kitakami\nOgre Clan! Now...have at you!

label: s1_sub_017_man_20
text: Hahaha! So you’ve managed to defeat even me!\nI must commend your strength!

label: s1_sub_017_man_22
text: ...Hah, just kidding! Thanks for taking part in\nour little event!

label: s1_sub_017_man_23
text: You see, the Kitakami Ogre Clan is actually a\nspecial campaign we run to train up the kiddos\r\nand let ’em experience the joys of battling.

label: s1_sub_017_man_24
text: We always hold this event around the same time\nas the Festival of Masks...

label: s1_sub_017_man_25
text: Problem is, our members don’t know how to hold\nback, so a kid’s never made it to the end before!

label: s1_sub_017_man_26
text: I think you might be the first one to defeat me!

label: s1_sub_017_man_27
text: So here, congrats! Take this prize!

label: s1_sub_017_man_28
text: Keep up your training in the land of Kitakami.\nGrow big and strong in the great outdoors!

label: s1_sub_017_man_29
text: Well, if it isn’t the first kid to defeat me! Come\nto pay me a visit? Haha, splendid! Just splendid!
